title: The stool's cracked seat
logline: The end stool's vinyl seat, close, cracked in a star, tape over it from years ago, the tape cracked too. Twenty years of one seat. Nobody on it; the page is under where he'd be.

panels.composition: Close on a shop stool's vinyl seat cracked in a star pattern with old tape over the crack also cracking, the counter's edge above.
